Lot of 5 Vintage Glass Electrical Insulators Hemingray Blue Green Clear
This lot includes 5 vintage glass electrical insulators featuring both aqua/blue-green and clear glass varieties. Two blue-green insulators are marked with 'HEMINGRAY' and 'MADE IN U.S.A.'. Each insulator is made of heavy, thick glass with a classic double-groove design. Most pieces exhibit signs of age including minor dirt, residue, and surface wear but have no major cracks or chips visible. The clear glass insulators include one with a partial label and some with embossed markings. These insulators were originally used on telegraph and power lines and are suitable for collectors or as decorative industrial items.

Perfect for an educational gift, a hands-on science tool, or a starter set for amateur collectors

description:
Lot of 3 Vintage Briar Smoking Pipes Century Imported Savinelli Asti Italy
This lot includes three vintage smoking pipes with distinct features. The first pipe is marked 'CENTURY OLD IMPORTED BRIAR,' made from polished briar wood with a metal band near the mouthpiece, showing moderate signs of use. The second pipe is a Savinelli 'Asti' model stamped with 'ASTI' and 'Italy,' featuring a partially rusticated and smooth finish, a bent stem, and a small logo on the mouthpiece, with typical vintage wear. The third pipe is an unbranded or faintly marked bent briar wood pipe with a metal band, heavily rusticated bowl, and a black curved stem, displaying notable patina and signs of use. All pipes are pre-owned with varying wear, suitable for collectors or restoration.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97

All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon.
